{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.42

|arg= local

|gr1= Weapons

|descr= Returns true if weapon is currently rested.

|s1= [[isWeaponRested]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>_rest = isWeaponRested player;</sqf>

<dl class="command_description">

<dt></dt>
<dd class="notedate">Posted on 2015-07-01 - 16:44 (UTC)</dd>
<dt class="note">[[User:AgentRev|AgentRev]]</dt>
<dd class="note">
You can force a unit out of bipod or resting with:
<sqf>_unit playMove "";</sqf>
</dd>

<dt><dt>
<dd class="notedate">Posted on 2015-07-12 - 11:00 (UTC)</dd>
<dt class="note">[[User:Killzone_Kid|Killzone_Kid]]</dt>
<dd class="note">
As of 1.49 <sqf>isWeaponRested player;</sqf> is the only current use of this command. You cannot detect remote player and you cannot detect local unit that is not a player. Might as well be a nullar command without argument.
</dd>
